lines: Ring Training Part 4: Why Ring Work Matters More as You Age

Rings aren't just for chasing muscle-ups. They're one of the few tools that build the joint stability your shoulders need to hold up decades into your training. In the final part of this four-part series, learn why ring work becomes more valuable, not less, as you age, and why the fundamentals are worth returning to indefinitely. Discover how to train for a shoulder that lasts.

sections.title: FIGHT GONE BAD
lines: How do you perform the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?

Perform 1 minute of work at each of the 5 stations. Move immediately to the next station after 1 minute. The clock does not reset or stop between exercises. One-minute break is allowed before repeating each round. One point is given for each rep, except on the rower where each calorie is one point.
How do you score the “Fight Gone Bad” workout?
*Score is the total cumulative number of repetitions completed of all movements in all 3 rounds.*

sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Stamina isn't just grit. It's a measurable marker of how efficiently your cells make and use energy, and the data behind it is staggering: one study found every 1 mL/kg/min bump in VO2 max bought an extra 45 days of life. In this article from the CrossFit Medical Society, the authors break down the cellular science — mitochondria, AMPK, PGC-1a — behind why CrossFit's high-intensity, constantly varied approach may be one of the most effective ways to build the metabolic resilience tied to a longer, more independent life.
